fact: On 28 September 2026 the Central Bank of Sudan Governor issued administrative decision no. 65 of 2026 cancelling the licence of SudanPay Digital, a licensed mobile payment institution and switch operator, under the Banking Business Regulation Act and the 2020 mobile payment institutions and 2013 payment systems regulations.
title: بنك السودان يلغي ترخيص سودان باي ديجيتال للدفع عبر الموبايل
